firmware_under_test.device: BTicino 4695 (HC/HS/L/N/NT4695, AM5875) four-zone temperature central unit

conditions: Executes the unmodified 128 KB M16C/60 Flash image (SHA-256 254e3daed3534a4bcbf31a42534f75c3a8148e4e65fdcbcd0ea73aa4c16c91e9) mapped read-only from hardware reset through PIC transceiver version ($24 -> $250011) and configurator ($2603 -> $26030<ZA><ZB><SLA>) initialization.

Peripheral I/O boundaries are deterministic controlled substitutes: 32 KB I2C EEPROM buffer, UART0 PIC frame RX/TX queue returning $00 TX-OK acknowledgements, fast return stubs for watchdog/LCD/RTC/keypad/buzzer hardware waits, system-tick advancement between main-loop iterations so queued zone-sync broadcasts complete, and controlled 10-bit ADC sample inputs for the periodic backup-battery load test.
Sanitized publication record: raw Flash/RAM code and variable addresses, disassembly mnemonics, archive credentials, and host filesystem paths are omitted.
limitations: Establishes instruction-level execution of 4695 Firmware 01.01.03 under controlled peripheral inputs; does not execute the on-board PIC transceiver firmware, external slave-probe firmware, or physical SCS bus hardware.
Gateway OpenWebNet framing and ACK/NACK socket behavior remain established separately by the 19 pinned own-firmware-oracle gateway runs.

Stock Ghidra SLEIGH M16C/60:LE:16:default has two translator quirks accounted for here: LDE.B/LDE.W disp20[A0] truncates disp20 to 16 bits (resolved by computing the architectural 20-bit disp20 + A0 address), and CMP.B:G carry uses signed s<= on byte operands (all tested program and setpoint bounds lie in 0x00..0x7F where signed and unsigned byte order agree).
